title: ZeroTier
summary: Join ZeroTier networks on the Cardputer Zero: node, IP and status.
description:
ZeroTier client for the Cardputer Zero. See every network you have joined, whether it is up, and the IP this node got, then switch networks without a laptop.

Features
- Node online state and 10 character node ID in the top bar
- One card per network: name, status (OK / OFF / REQ), assigned IP and network ID
- ENTER connects the selected network, D disconnects it after a confirmation, N joins a new network by entering its 16 digit ID
- Disconnect keeps the network in the list, so reconnecting later is one key press and no ID retyping
- 16 cell progress meter while typing a network ID
- Hold ESC for 3 seconds to leave the app, release to cancel
- Runs as a normal user; the only privileged command is zerotier-cli

Requirements
- The zerotier-one daemon must be installed (apt install zerotier-one) and online
- This package installs /etc/sudoers.d/cardputer-zerotier, which allows users to run exactly one command without a password: /usr/sbin/zerotier-cli
- Needs python3-pil and python3-numpy (declared as dependencies)
